description: An extension to the Pd/SuperCollider vstplugin project for the IEM Plug-in Suite. It makes the suite's OSC control interface available without requiring an actual OSC socket connection.

research.notes: The official IEM GitLab project and the IEM Plug-in Suite repository cross-reference this project. The repository spells its slug in lowercase, while the requested library name is preserved exactly. No issue tracker was verified.
